steps.title: Прочитайте ещё раз. Дополните предложение.
steps.before: At lunch she has a sandwich and
steps.html:
Nura

Hi! I'm Nura. I go to the same café every morning.

I'd like a coffee and a croissant, please.

There isn't any milk in my coffee — I drink it black.

At lunch I usually have a sandwich and some water.

steps.title: Прочитайте ещё раз. Дополните предложение.
steps.html:
Ali

Hi! I'm Ali. I work in a small shop in the centre.

People ask me: How much is this? How many do you want?

Our coffee is cheap — two euros. The cakes are expensive.

We don't have any umbrellas today. Sorry!

steps.title: Расставьте слова по порядку.
steps.answer: Could you buy me some apples?

steps.title: Найдите ошибку.
steps.answer: How many apples would you like?

steps.html:
Kamila

Hi! I'm Kamila. I live in Astana.

In winter it's very cold and snowy here.

Right now I'm at home and it's raining.

In summer it's hot and sunny. That's my favourite season.

steps.title: Расставьте слова по порядку.
steps.answer: In winter it is very cold.
